mapper.select: SELECT currency.currency_code, currency.my_rate, currency.rate_month FROM `date-project`.dim_lingxing_currency_month currency INNER JOIN ( SELECT currency_code, MAX(rate_month) rate_month FROM `date-project`.dim_lingxing_currency_month WHERE rate_month <= #{rateMonth} GROUP BY currency_code ) latest ON latest.currency_code = currency.currency_code AND latest.rate_month = currency.rate_month
